steps.content: The massive mask is impaled and split by the shackles, but new malice keeps pouring in, causing it to reassemble and expand again. If this continues, the connected Gray Mirror Space, its users, the Fifth Avenue, and even the entire Eastside will be overrun by this digitalized Mania. This will not end if the core of the monster is not crushed.
Where could the core be... You look at Bianca, who is leaning on your shoulder, weak and unconscious.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Once I have destroyed those bad guys, could you finish me off, for I have turned into a villain too?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bad deeds should be punished. Someone in this world can still judge me. This is a world of justice. This is my dream...
[Exit flashback]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I know you've decided to give up everything for this power. But if Mania hasn't devoured you completely, if you're still holding onto that initial dream of yours, even just a little...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Help me find the core.
The mask takes shape again, and a hurricane of Mania mixed with ruthless malice envelops the two of you, yet you stand unyielding, spikes of red light reaching into this broken puppet...
[Shackles][Blank Screen]

steps.speaker: Childish Cries
steps.content: *Cries sadly.
You hear a child's piercing cries from the depths of your consciousness.
You follow the cries through the white void and finally find their source.
[Little Bianca]

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: No... Sob... It's not fair... You're wrong, Miss!
She keeps crying and seems to get even angrier at her own words. The way she punches and kicks the air reminds you of someone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hey, stop crying. Here, I've got a treat for you.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: What treat?
The girl calms down as quickly as she acts up. Her tears immediately stop.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: An apple candy. Do you like it?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Wow! How did you know I like apples? My nickname is Apple. My parents say my head is big and my face is round and red, like an apple. But apples are too big for me to hold, so Mom makes apple purée for me! Have you tried it? It's warm and tasty!
And once she starts talking, she never stops, just like that person you know.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tell me why you were crying and I'll give you an apple candy, okay?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Sure! It's because a classmate was bullied just now!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: The kids from the Star Class were bullying a girl in overalls. Everyone was pulling at her straps, so she fell over! She fell so hard!

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Yes! But I'm from the Moon Class, and I don't know the kids from the Star Class, so I couldn't tell who was bullying her. I could only show the teacher. But they all said I was lying! Their teacher didn't believe me either, because I'm from the Moon Class! That made Apple so angry!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What about the bullied child? Didn't she speak up for you?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: She asked me not to tell the teacher. She said she was scared. Even if the teacher helped her this time, they would bully her again next time. She said I'm from the Moon Class, so I don't have to worry about that, but not her...

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: And then, and then, you saw me... Apple cried a lot! Apple was so embarrassed!...

options: That's not embarrassing. I didn't hear anything.
That's not true. Apple is the bravest.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I saw the brave Apple standing up for the weak and feeling upset about an unfair judgment.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Really...? Then, will the brave Apple win? Will those bad kids be punished?

options: Of course. Your voice will be heard.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Really?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: What if it's not the kids from the Star Class, but even more unknown and unidentifiable culprits?
You watch the girl grow up, pick up a camera, and get her press pass.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I thought growing up meant gaining power, but turns out not every fairy tale has a happy ending...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: It turns out the world isn't as black and white as I saw it when I was little...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: In the face of an endless journey, what should one do?

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Bianca, quick, think of something. There are many more of these kids in overalls...
Bianca lowers her head, as if looking at her younger self, lost and confused.
This is the center of the Mania monster's power. You've found the core. This is the earliest malice that fed the monster... Bianca's malice. But it's also the root of her initial dream.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...But you know that curbing violence with violence won't get you what you want. Even Gray Mirror can't bring you your ideal world.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Any advice then, Ashy? What will you do if you know it may all be futile even if you persist?
She looks up like a child waiting for a lesson from a teacher, eagerly awaiting your response. You can think of many examples of futile persistence... It seems all you can offer her is silence.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Haha, hahaha... You don't know either...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You don't know what to do either, but since you're more powerful than me, I must yield. Is that it?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, it's just that whatever I say seems useless. You've already yielded, but not to me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When you chose to take over the Gray Mirror server to execute your justice, you had already lost.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The brave little Apple who spoke up for the innocent lost to the temptation of power. The girl who thought the world should be black and white chose to be tainted with darkness herself.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You want evil to be justly punished. The journey to this goal is indeed long and tough, and the end might not be in sight for a long time. But the journalist named Bianca has already given up midway.

She stares at you blankly as the luminous spikes from the shackles firmly pierce through this embodiment of her obsession. Cracks appear on her body. Soon you hear the sharp noise of something breaking, and the vision before you shatters into fragments. You return to reality.
[Rooftop]

You've broken the core, and the colossal mask in the sky disintegrates into scattered green characters, rapidly vanishing. Bianca has woken up, her figure overlapping with that lonely, confused girl back in the consciousness.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: ...Hmph!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I don't understand what you jibber jabbered about nor do I want to hear! I won't listen to you! That wasn't a fair fight!

options: Maybe next time I'll let you win.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When you become Eastside's top journalist. We can have another match.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Sure, then when I become Eastside's top journalist, we'll drink apple juice together again! We'll drink till it gets dark!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: At the press award ceremony, you must sit closest to me and watch me receive my award!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But... they won't give an award to a villain, will they?
She suddenly goes silent, smiling at you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: I yield, Ashy. I won't play dirty.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You're right, I was judging others by my own standards. I'm no different from those who voted. I made a mistake. I'll accept my punishment!
She stands with her arms akimbo, lifting her head proudly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How will I punish you? I'm just a little "investigator".
She doesn't answer or expose your obvious lie, simply pulling out a can of apple juice from her pocket.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Here, take this. I promised you the prize.
You fumble to catch it, and when you look up again, Bianca is already running off into the distance without looking back.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wait, that's...!
[Blank Screen]
I know!
That's where the loveliest, bravest little Bianca is!

"Dear teacher of the Star Class, this is Bianca from the Moon Class. I want to say sorry to the kids in the Star Class, so my mommy is helping me write this letter. Because you didn't punish the bullies in the Star Class, I put some sand from the garden in their lunch milk as punishment."
"Now that we're even, you can punish me! But I won't give up. If I see kids from the Star Class bully others again, I will still tell on them!"
I must pick up the microphone and camera. I must let everyone see this!
I will keep going…
Keep going forward!
The end must lie ahead!

To this day, there's no news of Bianca. At the moment of her fall, Eastside detected an abnormal M-value peak near the TV station, and with your shackles on her, she has likely awakened as a Sinner. You're certain she's still alive, holding her camera and waiting for the next big news.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, many new apps have appeared lately.
Are they talking about me again?
Hecate nods, but she seems to have learned to ignore such pointless gossip and shuts down her device voluntarily.
Nightingale hands over a list.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's from Roxanne. They've traced the IPs from Gray Mirror and captured another batch of citizens who stirred public opinion and incited cyber violence.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Have they found out who sent the IP list?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: No, a city-wide manhunt has been launched, but Bianca's whereabouts are still unknown. The Public Security Bureau has promised to track her down. That being said, you may find this email useful, Chief.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Email?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This was sent to the MBCC's public domain email address this morning. It contains only a dark web link. The sender is anonymous, but with an... apple avatar.
